title: the Bell House Rising
author: Paloma Okonkwo
blurb: Isandro Oyelaran, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
